relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: mice that had been pretreated with a 100:1 CBD:THC (100 mg/kg CBD and 1 mg/kg THC) combination exhibited a complete rescue from light aversion induced by either CGRP (Figure 2(b)) or SNP (Figure 2(c))

relationships.subject: CGRP
relationships.evidence_quote: injection of CGRP (****p < 0.0001; Figure 2(b)) or SNP (**p = 0.0062; Figure 2(c)) led to a significant reduction in the time spent in the light chamber compared to PBS-injected mice

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 receptors, which can stimulate CGRP release

key_findings: A 100:1 CBD:THC combination rescued CGRP- and SNP-induced light aversion in both sexes and squint only in males.
The combination reduced CSD-induced grimace without changing CSD characteristics.
